The '''Bursoll system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bursoll II]], homeworld of [[Geben Arrulis]], was located in this system.
